author: Captain of the Serpent's Wake
pages:
To the crews of the Serpent Fleet.

The tide-callers report the Summerset patrols have thinned along the western channel. We sail on the dark of the moon.

Take what floats, sink what doesn't. Bring the serpent-handlers forward. The prince wants the Altmer to remember whose sea this is.

Any captain who loses his ship to weather instead of steel will answer to the deep.
